company_info.company_description: "Adelaide-based DQ Electrical provides end-to-end residential, commercial and industrial support. Our team of highly-skilled electricians are committed to delivering efficient, low-cost solutions, tailored to your individual budget and requirements.We design, supply and install a complete custom photovoltaic (PV) system to your individual specifications. During the initial consultations, we’ll offer various system options and configurations, based on your property layout and needs. SAA accredited, our solar technicians are qualified to handle all capacities of the solar energy system work.The DQ ethos is accompanied by long-lasting relationships, exceptional service standards and competitive prices. We work with home owners, businesses, builders and real estate agents.Our people are passionate about the industry and believe that professionalism and dedication to providing excellent customer service are key to achieving ongoing success as a growing local business. Whether you need us to replace a faulty light fitting or power point, install a custom solar energy system or design the entire switchboard for your industrial space, hire our licensed electricians.We’re available between 7.00am – 8.00pm Monday to Friday, and by appointment on the weekends. Let’s talk about your needs. Organise a free measure and quote with us today. Determine whether solar power is for you."

reviews.review_description: There's a reason why DQ Electrical has a waiting period and a backlog of jobs.I'm more than happy to wait.DQ Electrical is possibly the best in the game in Adelaide.Steve was very knowledgeable, asked all the right questions, and didn't shame other installers or brands. Good, honest, straightforward advice.DQ designed a system with significantly more capacity for generation and storage than the other quotes, at a similar cost.Their systems for communication keep you very up to date with progress

My brother and I shopped around and DQ was on our list as it was recommended by the electrician who built my house who said DQ use employed sparkies rather than contractors who get paid per panel. The panels installed were better quality that the other quote we were considering from RAA and DQ came to the party re price. Within weeks it was installed looking neat and I found myself thinking of why I didn’t do this earlier.

Out of those that we requested a quote from, DQ Electrical were the only ones that came to inspect the property, go through the installation procedure with us and provide information on the product that they were installing.Even though the installation did not occur on the date specified in the quote, they kept in contact with us so that we knew when this would be and could plan around this.The installation was carried out in a very professional manner, with full credit going to the tradesmen who did this work.All the necessary paperwork that was associated with this installation was handled by the supplier on our behalf for which we are truly thankful.

DQ Electrical provided a competitive quote and right through to completion of the works the process was seamless. Don and his team were highly professional from start to finish and delivered 100% on their scope.Our Head Office runs a 24/7 network train control centre and in order to ensure continuous power to the site DQ worked very closely with our electrical contractors.I recommend DQ highlyBilly O'DohertyNational Facilities AdvisorARTC
I appreciated their patience with the sales quoting process and communication around the installation date.  Installation all went smoothly and the new battery looks great!

DQ electrical did a great job from quoting right through to installation and handover. The installers arrived on time and after the install took the time to show me how everything worked. They kept me informed throughout the process. I would recommend them if you are looking at installing solar at your property.
Yes all of the above. The whole process was effective

Sales person was knowledgeable and helpful, the customer service staff have always been accommodating and the installation went as expected.  The installation engineers thoroughly checked everything was working before they left rather than skipping off early.  This is the second time I have used DQ Electrical and would do so again.

DQ Electrical recently guided us through the process to replace an old solar system with a new system including a battery. The company demonstrated a good understanding of our needs and presented a proposal that met these needs and within our budget.Although installation was delayed partially as a result of increased demand due to the new home battery rebate scheme, the wait was worth it. Installation was over within a day and after two weeks all is going well. The work included updates to safety switches and changes to a controlled load hot water service to ensure we maximise use of our generated power.Highly recommended as a local Adelaide supplier.

In short, very happy with the services received from DQ Electrical right from the quotation to installation/commissioning stages.  I have no hesitation to highly recommend DQ Electrical for Tesla Powerwall installation.Nathan, a very technically competent and pleasant individual, visited my home and after inspection, provided me with a proposal which was far superior technically than the other three quotes I got.  I am not sharing the details here as that may provide significant clues to their competition.The installation was exactly as promised.  There was no gap whatsoever between their detailed design / installation and my understanding of what I was getting.Josh and team did the installation / commissioning on the scheduled date efficiently, without any fuss and demonstrated attention to details.  The commissioning included detailed testing of all key components/functionalities including the App setup and blackout testing.In my view, DQ Electrical demonstrated their focus on customers’ interest throughout the process, which is not the case for many contractors in this field.  For example, one of the vendors I took quote from, tried to increase the price by exactly the amount of Federal subsidy!!!!  No such stunt from DQ Electrical.All people from DQ Electrical I interacted with, in person as well as on phone (their office staff) were pleasant and responsive.  They always kept their promise.Only issue I faced with them was a period of complete silence after the order was placed and advance paid.  However, after my follow-up, things got back on track.  This probably was because of very high demand after the Federal subsidy kicked in.

The DQ Electrical team arrived early in the morning to replace 28 old solar panels, install 40 new ones and a battery. They completed the job in a day. From the first quotes to the completed project they impressed me as a highly skilled professional team who knew what they were doing and stayed focussed throughout. They reminded me of a team of gun shearers.  They were polite, courteous and always helpful. A group of really impressive young blokes. They took all the rubbish with them and their work was neat and looked great. I can’t speak highly enough of them.
From quoting, to queries and install, Steve and the team we're competitive and easy to work with.

For the 5th time over the past 6 years DQ Electrical have put in a winning bid for sustainability upgrades at our model eco-village Christie Walk. We’re always very pleased to have the highly-skilled and well-trained team of DQ electricians on site. They respect our property, arrive well-prepared and briefed for the job and achieve difficult wiring tasks, installation and commissioning remarkably quickly, whilst still taking all care to do the job properly to ensure smooth and reliable running once they leave the site. Each time Don Quattrocchi and his team have gone the extra distance, working with us to plan innovative solutions for the inevitable problems of retrofitting into crowded spaces. The installation was completed a month earlier than originally scheduled, so we’re delighted.DQ Electrical jobs on our site have ranged from a major PV upgrade, then our first home battery, followed by a second home battery, then a heat pump hot water system upgrade and now in July 2025 adding our 3rd and 4th Tesla Powerwalls plus a Tesla Wall Connector for EV charging. Very highly recommended; couldn’t ask for better.

I did my research and homework when shopping for my solar system provider and we have never had reason to regret choosing DQ Electrical. This install is our 2nd DQ Electrical solar system - twice as large as the first and with batteries. DQ as always have been super helpful, providing us first rate expertise and service. True 'subject matter experts', solar and batteries are DQ's core business, which was valuable for us on our complex install. Navigating the financials, politics and changing rebate environment, we were scheduled for installation in the week of the federal election energy policy announcements! Fact-finding, recalculating, adapting and re-specifying on the fly highlighted DQ's expertise and efforts to ensure we got the quality outcome we were seeking and best value option. I highly recommend DQ Electrical as a provider of good value, high quality equipment and installations.
Quote was easy and fixed. Accessed through solar quotes website. Happy with whole process and job was completed on time and was finished off neatly and completely

DQ Electrical did a great job with installing solar battery from quote to installation.  Their service was next to none, great communication and comparable pricing. They were very thorough in explaining the different options for the battery to suit the existing solar panels and the best location for it.  I would highly recommend them.  The battery itself has been performing as expected.  Thank goodness I had it installed when I did, a week later I had an outage for 2 days and the battery got me through without any headaches.

Solar quotes helped us in recommending 3 installers wherein we decided to get DQ Electrical. This company was also recommended by my friend where he also got his battery and solar system. There was a little difference from the price that DQ quoted to us but the inverter and panels they used are really good quality after watching various research and reviews. The process from the quote up to the final installation went very smoothly, and they have very friendly and accommodating staff. I will definitely recommend DQ to my friends as well.

From the initial interview and product selection through to the contract and finally the installation it was all seamless.For me they had the combination of products that suited my installation. As I had a small section of roof the Aiko panels with their high output and small area were perfect. Add a Fronius inverter and an 11 kW BYD battery I have a powerful system.All dealing with the staff at DQ Electrical have been a pleasure, they are are competent and friendly team who I would not hesitate to recommend to anyone seeking a quality system.

The sales people at DQ Electrical took time to understand the particular needs for my new battery setup. They proposed a technical solution that fits well with my existing solar system. Our battery was installed two days ago by two DQE electricians. Like the sales staff, they too were friendly and professional.  Before leaving our house the installers made sure that the battery controller was connected to the internet, and that my wife and I had the App set up on our phones and were able to monitor the new system. The installers cleaned up afterwards and took all packaging and rubbish with them. Excellent Service DQ Electrical!

Communication was great. Very clear and prompt. Sales matched our needs best. Installation was fantastic. The team were polite, efficient,  punctual, friendly  and a great team. Our site was left tidy and clear instructions were given about our system and how to use it. Very impressed.

Out of our 3 options DQ Electrical were simply more professionalDQ Electrical were the only company that came to the house fully prepared with images of our roof what the panels would look like on the roof,  details of how much we'd be saving roughly on our bill, told us the options about what we'd need if we wanted to add a battery later and had a quote for panel install ready for us.

We had the pleasure of working with Joshua aka BB and his team of exceptional installers, and from start to finish, their professionalism was evident in every step of the process.Joshua, as the lead installer, ensured that everything was done with precision and care, guiding the team with expertise and dedication. They were punctual, never missing a scheduled time, and ensuring the installation flowed seamlessly. Their commitment to their work was unwavering, leaving us confident in the quality of their craftsmanship.What stood out most was their courteous reflection every day ended with a proper goodbye. Even when I continued talking as they were leaving, they never turned their backs on me, instead, they respectfully waited until I said goodbye. It was a small gesture that spoke volumes about their integrity and respect for their clients.A special mention also goes to Admin (Mary) and General Manager (Ben), who ensured everything was well-coordinated and professionally handled behind the scenes. Their responsiveness and attention to detail made the process smooth, demonstrating a commitment to customer care and high standards.If you value precision, reliability, and respectful service, this team is the one to trust. Highly recommended!

With no prior experience with a solar system that included a battery we asked many questions about how the solar system worked.  Their assistance and responses enable us to have a good working knowledge prior to installation.On the first day of installation the lead installer checked the layout for 4 banks of solar panels totalling 38 units, and the electrician was happy to discuss and explain system settings.I would not hesitate to recommend DQ Electrical.

Steve promptly arranged a time for a quote.He took the time to explain how batteries work and the additional benefits that can be an option such as VPP programs.Steve was not pushy following the quote either which I appreciated.The installers for the company were awesome,Cameron is an asset to your company. His service skills are top notch.The workmanship was fantastic.I would certainly recommend DQ Electricl.

The team at DQ Electrical were attentive to my requests and supported me in my decision-making while knowing full well I was comparing many quotes.Their attention to detail even at the quoting stage is what put them ahead of their competition and accommodated a rather tricky install of the inverter running conduit through 2 stories of wall to keep the final product neat.On the day of the installation, the guys were pleasant and answered any questions I had and when it was time to turn everything on they ran me through the app and handled all the SAPN documentation.I strongly recommend the team at DQ Electrical and when the time comes for a battery I will be sure to contact them again.
Good sales consulting process, good installation. Battery size was the best I could get for my budget. All my queries were answered.

I am 77ys old, I live alone, my old system failed. I had may quotes from different firms before I was told about your website, which I found so helpful and informative. Two of the three companies you recommended got in touch, DQ Electrical was the only company out of all of them to not automatically quote on a much larger system than I required.I wished to retain the 44c I receive for my solar energy. I had to wait a while for the system to be installed as they were so busy, but it was installed 17/3/2025. So far, so good, I am happy with the company and your recommendation. I have already told my friends of your website. Thanks.

Sales and quoting process was quick and efficient. Invoice was well laid out and information easy to read. The insulation was done on the day they told me and the two man team arrived on time and completed efficiently. They cleaned the site and left it tidy. Brad explained how to Down load the app and showed me how to use it. Very professional and polite, friendly men. Delighted to do business with them.
I found DQ very easy to deal with and got exactly what I expected. The work was neat and the job was managed well
The installers were extremely polite and didn’t leave any mess. Was shown how to check my unit via an app they installed and how to use it.

Deciding to install a solar system with battery, along with an EV Charger is a daunting process and not for the faint hearted. Thank goodness for Solarquotes as we would not have attempted this without their critical help.However, once embarked on this adventure, we had little hesitation in selecting DQ Electrical. Nathan was warm, expertly knowledgeable and professional, and covered "everything" and the quote we received was comprehensive, easy to understand matched the Solarquotes checklist. The Installing Team were also polite, professional and efficient and there was no fuss as they removed and replaced our old panels with the new syatem.A standout was our electrician Josh Ravesteyn who expertly wired everything up, commissioned our systems  and took time to explain how it all works and how to download and use the APP. He also returned to make sure our new panels were properly cleaned.We are the proud new owners of a high quality new solar system with the latest Aiko panels, a Powerwall 3 battery and Zappi EV charger and most thankful we chose DQ Electrical as our supplier and installer. Rob & Leonie

We were completely satisfied with sales and quoting process and with the onsite attendance to look at the options and the placement of equipment.The installation was done on time and with minimum fuss and no intrusion on the running of the Club.The handover was well explained and instruction on closing down and re-starting clearly detailed.

The whole process of working with DQ Electrical was excellent. I worked with Don initially and price was very competitive with other quotes for the 13 kw system. I had a lot of confidence and trust in Don, as I knew he was an electrician himself and was very straightforward and easy to deal with.Installation was a very easy matter. Brad and his team were extremely professional and competent. The job happened very quickly with no fuss.Extremely impressed and satisfied with the whole process.

We initially contacted DQ Electrical during our build and arranged a site visit and quote. They were really quick providing us a quote and gave us numerous options which was great to balance between what we wanted and what we were able to afford. Due to their quick response they were able to undertake electrical provisions during the build. Once the house was built and we were ready for installation Callum and the team arrived nice and early and got straight into the installation. They all worked really well as a team, communicating well amongst themselves and keeping me updated on the progress so I felt reassured and confident in their work. After the installation was complete, the team packed and cleaned everything up while Callum set up and showed me through the mobile app. He further showed me the components of the battery and inverter, its isolation procedure and the additions to our switch board. Since the installation we have received a follow up phone call checking in to see how everything is going, if there are any issues and if we need any further assisting with the app. Overall we have been delighted by the installers professionalism and attention to detail. We WILL definitely be recommending the company and specifically Ben & Callum!
Here's hoping cheaper electricity bills too early to tell but according to app all good

DQ Electrical were the only company to come to our home, the rest did quote over the phone. I loved that! They came out a second time to explain more about the system and the savings to expect. Just brilliant. Even though there were problems with product failure, not their fault they came out to replace the component promptly. They care about the customer and provide excellent after sales service. The were polite, and nothing was too much trouble.I would thoroughly recommend DQ Electrical.

It was straightforward in purchasing processing. They explained everything to me and performed a site visit prior to installation which I appreciated a lot.Staff were very polite during the installation day and everything went smoothly.I place a lot of value on their after sales service. Instead of dumping you away after you have paid for everything, they will act and answer your questions promptly.They identified 1 out of 4 my Sungrow batteries was faulty and organised for warranty + able to put that in within 2 weeks.I am glad that I chose them, and no wonder they require a relatively long wait (6 weeks from purchase to my installation). But I'm still happy with that wait period since they did an awesome job :)

The team at DQ Electrical provided an excellent experience from start to finish. The initial sales calls went smoothly, nothing pushy and all options were explained clearly. The sales team were knowledgeable on the products they were offering. A site inspection was arranged in short time, with the inspection being thorough enough that there were no surprises for the installation team.The DQ installation team were fantastic. They were prompt on the day, very well presented and conducted themselves professionally throughout the day. Their workmanship was impressive, seeing them complete the bulk of the installation within the day.I am very happy with DQ electrical as my choice of installer.The entire experience with DQ Electrical is a credit to Don and the work environment he creates for his staff.

Added a battery, more solar panels and upgraded my inverter. The guys from DQ Electrical showed up on time, did a really professional and clean installation, and took the time to go through the new app as well as reconfiguring my old analytics app and equipment. Thanks for all the hard work and care taken throughout the journey.

Turnaround from quoting to installation was only a couple of weeks. Don was very responsive and happy to make changes to the quote as necessary.Installation was also quick and straightforward. It only took one day instead of two. The installers were punctual and cleaned up after themselves.

DQ was recommended to me and I'm glad it was. As soon as I had made my initial call their rep came to see me that afternoon.  He explained solar to me, recommended what was best for my needs, didn't try to sell me more than I needed. It was a reasonable price. The workmen arrived when they said they would and got on and did the installation.  They showed me how to check my usage through an app from my phone. When my smart meter was installed the electrician (not from DQ) hadn't completed some wires correctly and my phone app wasn't working. After a phone call to DQ their electrician was at my house within about 2 hours and had it all sorted...what great service,  thanks Don.

DQ Electrical have been an absolute pleasure to deal with from start to finish. Nathan listened to what we wanted to achieve and designed a system accordingly. At the site inspection he went through the entire process, explained the system in great detail, answered all our questions and went over any final points to ensure the system was suited to our needs.The installation was seemless, Michael and his team did a fantastic job. They were here on time on the day of the booking, something that seldom seems to happen these days. They were extremely polite and accommodating, and the quality of their craftsmanship is beyond reproach, they obviously take great pride in their work. The finished product is extremely neat and not at all obtrusive. The handover process was excellent with Michael talking through the operation of the system, assisting with setting up the app and going over any final points. When they left, you wouldn't know that had been there other than the shiny new panels on the roof. The app itself is brilliant, so easy to use, and you can see in realtime exactly what the system is doing, great for monitoring how much power you actually use.Naturally for a job like this we had a number of quotes. While DQ Electrical were not the cheapest, they were the only one that was able to provide complete home back up and were still very comparable on price.We have not had the system very long at this point but so far it is delivering everything that was promised.

The DQ Electric total team performance was impeccable from the initial contact, the design and quotation process, the admin staff dealing with scheduling and invoices, thru to the installation. And of course the biggest impact is always the installation (which included removal of an older smaller system), and that too was accomplished with minimum inconvenience, the installation team were punctual, courteous, tidy, and professional right thru to installing the monitoring website. And in the end the system they designed for us is performing beyond expectation. Couldn’t be more satisfied, an excellent investment.

From the start to the end all very good service. It was the day of the storms and the lads come out early and just started the job straight away, they kept me in loop the whole time. They were so polite and show me everything once finished.

A great experience from Sales to Installation; Very friendly, courteous service from the whole team. Installed Monday and I was shown what to expect in a blackout situation - Thursday night we had a blackout (we didn't realise it at first) - the system worked perfectly!!! This already supports our decision to have a battery installed as well.

Our existing solar system, more than 12 years old failed and we requested DQ Electrical to evaluate and provide a proposal.Callum from DQ, within minutes identified the fault and proposed that all old solar panels and inverter should be replaced.Nathan from DQ visited and proposed excellent options which were extensively discussed.  Nathan provided a comprehensive quotation, which we accepted.  Callum's initial callout fee was waived because we proceeded with DQ's quote for the upgrade.Callum and his installation team members Caleb and Harrison removed the existing system and installed 30 new panel and 2 Sungrow inverters.  Don provided final inspection.  The whole job was completed within a day plus a few hours.  Exceptional!In all aspects, from Callum's first visit, Nathan's quotation and the supply and installation was undertaken in a very courteous, respectful and professional manner.  Specifically, the completed installation is exceptional, the site was left tidy and clean.  Callum and his team were always polite and respectful of our property.  I cannot commend and recommend them highly enough.Well done and we are very happy customers!

From initial quoting to installation it was a very smooth process with DQ.I compared few installer in Adelaide and DQ came with the lowest quote with good equipments.Installation was done by DQ technicians and everything was cleaned pretty well after the installation.Panels look great on roof and installation is neat and clean.

Nathan was the only person to come to site and give a real quote. He took the time to find the restraints and limitations of our home and circumstances. I had 4 other quotes from other companies, everyone else used an aerial photo and guesswork.10/10 for service

From start to finish I felt the family business vibes from  DQ Electrical (in the best way possible). In comparison to the other installers that gave me quotes, it felt like Nathan actually understood my vision/requirements and as a result provided me with the best cost to requirement solutions. It felt like he did go above and beyond to help explain some of his decision making process for this and answered every question I had to remove any doubt.Installation was great, group of very polite guys who were able to remove my old system, and install a new system + battery without leaving any rubbish or bits behind.They made sure I was familiar with all of the changes that were made and gave me confidence in the purchase/company.

Installers were absolute professionals and nice guys to deal with and their attention to detail was impeccable. I would fully recommend DQ electrical for all solar needs.Don and his team's customer service made the sales process, install and grid connection organisation was awesome.
Quote was clear, level of service great,  installers very good. Highly recommend

My experience with DQ Electrical was excellent from start to finish. The sales and quoting process was straightforward, and they provided detailed explanations without overwhelming technical jargon. The installation team was polite, punctual, and remarkably tidy, leaving no mess behind.The customer service was top-notch; they assisted in organizing the grid connection seamlessly after the installation. Moreover, they took the time to demonstrate how to use the charger effectively, ensuring I understood everything before they left. Overall, the process was smooth, and I'm delighted with how well everything works.
Josh and the team was professional and polite. Excellent job of the installation.
Excellent service from initial sales quote, revisions upon further discussion with GM, to install team.19kW Battery and further 8kW of panels added to existing array.

Started off with Steve looking into my situation and advising me to keep my old inverter and panels and to install new panels and new inverter to bring my system up from 4 to 10Kw. He was able to answer all questions re future battery install, smart meter concerns and recommended tariff based on my previous power bill.Then the installers arrived at exactly 7.30 as agreed and installed 13 panels and an inverter within about 6 hours.I had the system explained to me and was shown the basics of the inverter app so I could monitor the solar panels.They didn't leave any mess and were very courteous the whole time.Extremely impressed.

Had a lot of back forth communication with DQ sales staff on a system and price. Looked at a variety of scenarios resulting in a few iterations of quotes. Their staff was patient with all my questions and concerns.Ultimately, we decided on a sungrow battery system with new hybrid inverter that could backup the entire property on 3 phase if the grid went out. DQ were able to remove the old inverter, rewire exisitng panels and added an extra 22 panels to max out the best roof positions.Their quote was the most competitive when we narrowed down to only 2 potential installers.Work looks clean and tidy.Total installed equipment.22x jinko panels 9.68kwSH15T hybrid inverterSBR160 16kw (5 stack) batteryResult, full house backup across 3 phases.

I am very pleased with my interactions with DQ Electrical, from the initial quoting which was thorough and comprehensive, the installation and follow up afterwards. I was able to compare my quote with other providers and could clearly see that some of my quotes hadn’t been personalised to reflect my usage and my existing system. I was happy to see my DQ quote was detailed and included all the information I needed, bonus that the price was very reasonable too. Prior to installation I was kept informed of the installers expected arrival time and agenda for the day. Both Josh and Cameron were friendly, polite and knowledgeable. At the end of a long day they took the time to clean up nicely and explain how to use the equipment. I was shown how to read the App so I can keep track of how quickly my battery recharges each day and my usage. I’m so glad I took the leap into sustainable energy.

Happy with both system and panels.Installers carried out work quickly and left the place clean.Supervisor explained instruction in an easy and efficient manner.They gave two free Clipsal Cortex as additional monitoring meters.Luke offered outstanding phone support from day one as well as all the details regarding solar panel operations and government rebates.I highly recommend their service and products.
Customer service installation sales person all amazing. Best business dealt with in years A1

Happy with both system and panels.Installers carried out work quickly and left the place clean.Supervisor explained instruction in an easy and efficient manner.Luke offered outstanding phone support from day one as well as all the details regarding solar panel operations and government rebates.I highly recommend their service and products.

Every step of the process was professional and continually informed. From initial sit inspection prior to the home build completion, through to planning, administration, payments, and if course installation.Over the two days of install, Callum and Josh continued with ongoing consultation and checking in to ensure we were fully informed every step of the way. Apprentices Patrick and Cam did a lot of the heavy lifting and were just as professional and polite. At the end, everything was clean and tidy, and it all worked as expected.Great experience. Highly recommended.

We engaged with Finn Solar who we had dealt with 15 yrs ago when we 1st put on solar at our home. This was a positive experience and went through the same process. DQ Electrical was 1 of the 3 businesses that were recommended. From the start when we received the 1st point of contact to the time that we farewelled our installer, the process was just so simple. The time taken to explain the process, answering many questions that we had was of no trouble. Nathan was extremely patient with us and the quality of his assessment when we had a face to face meeting at our home, he was able to assess out home and even pointed out that our switchboard was no longer compliant with the current regulations was the reason DQ got the job.We are affected by a large council tree that potentially would affect our ability to reap the benefits of solar power and battery storage, Nathan made subtle changes to the layout of the panels to the point we were able to run an 11.2Kw system and kiss our electricity bill goodbye.Our installer Michael was very professional and so easy to talk to. His mannerism and workmanship was second to none. His team were extremely polite and engaging with questions posed on the days of the installation. Careful attention to remove the old system and clean up of the property was much appreciatedIt is reassuring to know that DQ Electrical will follow up with us in coming months so that we can be fed back how the system is working.We love investing in local business and cannot recommend DQ electrical highly enough.To all the staff thank you for your hard work

DQ Electrical Pty Ltd had installed the Tesla II for me, from quoting to the job done very smooth procedures, Punctual, Responsiveness, the whole team are very friendly and polite. I personally admire this company the way they do businessNo cut corner and no sub-contractors, peoples come to installed are DQ employee.Thank you DQ teamwork

Very professional operation right from the first contact  …. starting with Ben for the site visit and layout and quote , and the installation team lead by Josh their attention to detail and execution was excellent, lastly but not least the admin that kept me advised throughout the process also arranged grid connection,Thank once again DQ

I'm moving to the Clare valley, north of Adelaide and according to the locals, there aren't any local solar installers. I have seen a number of dodgy and non-compliant installs there though and I know of one otherwise reputable company that doesn't do exclusion zones.So I begged DQ Electrical to do the job. Well, if they are good enough for the owner of "SolarQuotes" to get them to cross to the south side of Adelaide, they should be good enough for me.I must admit that I prefer to talk to technicians than sales people and once that hurdle was cleared, it was all plain sailing. S****, really nice guy, patient, responsive to all my questions, always called me back but (and they'll both be upset at me saying this) B*******, the technical manager knows all the edge question answers.One of the reasons for wanting DQ Electrical to do the work is that this is a new build and the only company who would not sub out any of the work and uses only their own staff. DQ were happy to apply for a mains power connection from SAPN, helped me with getting power to the site rather than SAPN's option of power half way up a pole, some 60 metres from the property.They fitted the meter board, ran conduit and a pull cord under the drive to where the pit will eventually be. Working with the earthworker and plumber, they did the trenched cabling to the new shed, back down to the place for the septic tank, across to where the slab for the house will be. Josh, on his preliminary visit confirmed the roof sizing was correct for the number of panels I wanted and installed the underground conduits out from the shed prior to the concreting. And installed what were going to be 2 spare ones over and above what I thought were the maximum I needed. They will be used for another 2 strings of panels on the house: originally the house wasn't going to have any panels, just the 30 on the shed. I'm so glad that Josh used his initiative and installed those spares.The solar, inverter and Sungrow battery went in and then the guys moved on to doing the lighting, power, rainwater tank pump and provision for EV charging. They even found other jobs to do whilst I was speaking to Tech Support at Rheem about a supercharged resistive hot water system to gobble up the midday sun. Yup we needed a bigger capacity cable than we thought.
